findings.documented: Booklet PDF2/10 states 357.47 cents/kWh = R3.5747/kWh excluding VAT from 1 July 2026 for residential Scales 3, 4, 8, 9 and 13; service charge is included. PDF9 describes applicability.
findings.outstanding: Confirm the actual municipal scale using account/bill evidence in existing tariff verification. Do not assume FBE Scale12, net billing, TOU or business tariffs are interchangeable. Source rate/unit/date extraction is supported; account applicability is not thereby certified.

findings.documented: Tariff tables PDF272: CCMGMT, monthly distribution charge payable per submeter, R30.50 for 2026/27 excluding VAT. This is a per-submeter amount.
findings.outstanding: No evidence equates CCMGMT directly to the existing W_MGT aggregate property charge. Verify service and quantity/allocation basis. Do not copy R30.50 into an aggregate charge, multiply by an assumed meter count, or alter W_MGT calculations.

findings.documented: Tariff tables PDF270 lists R21.60 for underground leaks for individual dwellings. MTREF PDF31 describes proposed policy clarification of a fixed monthly levy on domestic water customers.
findings.outstanding: The monthly basis is described, but adopted policy and applicability to individual/bulk meters or dwellings are not established. Do not silently equate per-dwelling/per-customer wording with every registered meter.

findings.documented: Tariff tables PDF262: domestic bag collection once weekly, per month or part; exemption at valuation <=R400000; charged categories R62.53, R107.83, R139.04, R184.23, R246.98 and R305.95 excluding VAT.
findings.outstanding: Confirm exact municipal valuation and service/billing category. Knowing only that valuation exceeds R350000 does not choose a 2026/27 bracket or establish non-exemption. An existing amount matching an old band is not proof of classification.
